_comment: The 'scoring', 'hit' and 'crowd_hit' sections are hashed (see scoring.config_hash) and the hash is stored with every scored week, so any later edit to the hit definition is visible in the data. 'run' and 'report' are operational knobs and are not hashed.
_scoring_history: v1 (hash b5b540cb6e, through 2026-10-13): the ten categories up to two_pt_conversion. v2 (hash 476e6708f0, 2026-10-13): + sack, return_yd, return_td, fumble_recovery_td, after reading the league's own Yahoo settings (league/league_data.py check-scoring). The league also docks 4 points for a pick-six thrown; that is not scored here.

trend._comment: Breakout-trend observations (tracker/trends.py), observation only, never part of the official record. Pre-registered 2026-10-20 (docs/tracker_handoff.md, decision 15); hashed on its own (trends.trend_hash), NOT with the sections above. Any change is a new version.
